contract.taut_certificate: For a material run between held anchors, L=sum rest lengths; prove a geometric LOWER bound D on every admissible route. Insufficient length iff D > L*(1+hard_strain_tolerance)+absolute_length_tolerance.
contract.always_valid_bound: Euclidean anchor distance, irrespective of obstacles. This may be too weak to establish tautness around an obstacle.
contract.obstacle_bound: Exact convex-prism route in this fixture, or a certified inner obstacle approximation with a proved routing/escape condition. A sampled shortest polyline or outer obstacle approximation is generally an UPPER bound, not a proof.
contract.no_general_mesh_oracle: For general knot/cloth mesh obstacles where no stronger certified lower bound is available, a failed solve is Unresolved. These controls do not supply a universal 3D shortest-path oracle.
contract.solver_acceptance: A geometric bound below L is necessary, not sufficient. Require converged material constraints AND full contact certificate before committing; otherwise roll back complete state.
contract.handle_boundary: All moving/waiting/arrived/stopped handle positions remain held through every solve and final relaxation; move only the selected handle target for each candidate.
contract.threshold: 1e-4 is only an illustrative separator for .25cm coarse steps and solver strain tolerance1e-6. It cannot be used as the taut proof; off-grid and small-bound-excess controls show why.
contract.scope: Geometry and injected transaction controls; no claim that native Pull or friction/thick-cord contact has passed.

settings.model: Continuous zero-thickness flexible cord around an infinite circular cylinder; reference only, not a finite chord chain.

expected.reason: Finite face drum and finite straight cord chords have different exact geometry.

settings.obstacle_semantics: Declared closed convex solid; triangle winding and supplied normals face outward.
settings.route_side: upper z route, preserve by CCD

geodesic_shape_bounds.conditions: Whole final polyline outside the prism, z>=0, |y|<10, exact endpoint pins. Necessary only: individual edge, pin, static-contact and sweep gates remain mandatory.
geodesic_shape_bounds.formula: sqrt(s*(L-s)*(2epsilon+epsilon^2)); CAT(0) comparison about the unique upper geodesic at material fraction s/L.

expected.scope: Exact zero-thickness piecewise-linear geometry. Contacting initial/final states must support tangential motion; CCD stalling at a valid touch is unresolved contact, not taut.

settings.advance_rule: If the exact geometric limit is inside a step, clip/bracket it to length tolerance; do not call the last coarse accepted point exact taut.

expected.geometry_rule: Euclidean endpoint distance is a valid lower bound on every curve connecting held handles.
expected.shape_scope: Exact zero-strain taut chain is unique. With admitted edge strain, use the derived straight_shape_bounds and still check every edge and pin. Recompute about actual endpoints if pins differ; add their interpolated reference error when comparing to ideal coordinates. Reachable slack witness is not mandatory solver coordinates.
